fleet.title: <ac>{count} types</ac> of purple bus — choose one to fit your group
fleet.cta: Get a quote for this vehicle
fleet.disc: Seating capacity and options may vary slightly depending on the vehicle assigned. Whether parking fees and 10% VAT are included will be stated separately on your quote.

lines.bus45: A large coach used for group workshops, field trips and religious groups.
lines.bus35: Sized for medium groups. Used for everything from social gatherings and family trips to commuter service.
lines.limo28: Premium seats with generous legroom. Recommended for occasions that call for a touch of class, such as foreign VIP visits, sightseeing, weddings and funerals.
lines.bus25: A sensible choice for small groups. Suited to trips of around 20 people, such as university retreats and workshops.
lines.bus16: Suited to airport pickup & drop-off and small-group trips. It gets into narrow streets easily, which makes it a strong fit for city itineraries.

company.lead: Thank you sincerely for visiting the Bestour website.
body: Through thorough vehicle care and safe driving as an everyday habit, Bestour makes "a safe and happy trip for our customers" its top management priority.
Travel gives life a pause. As your companion on that journey, Bestour will keep working hard, today as always.

gallery.title: Places the purple bus <ac>has been</ac>

meta.title: Request a Quote — {brand}
meta.description: Request a charter bus quote in 6 steps. Just tell us your vehicle and schedule to submit a request; we will review it and send you a quote by text message.

quote.title: Request a charter bus quote in 6 steps
quote.sub: Just tell us your vehicle and schedule to submit a request. We will review it and send you a quote by text message.

purpose.name: Purpose
purpose.title: What is the trip for?
purpose.desc: Choose the trip purpose that is closest to yours.
purpose.label: Trip purpose

vehicle.name: Vehicle
vehicle.title: Which vehicle do you need?
vehicle.desc: Choose a vehicle that fits your group size. Picking one with a little more capacity than you need makes loading luggage easier.
vehicle.label: Vehicle type

lines.bus45: A large coach for group events · Ask about DVD, karaoke, refrigerator and other amenities
lines.bus35: Mid-size groups and workshops · A mid-size coach that gets into narrow roads and parking lots easily
lines.limo28: Wide seats, comfortable over long distances · Premium seating · Recommended for trips with older passengers
lines.bus25: Small gatherings and training trips · A coach suited to all kinds of small-group itineraries
lines.bus16: Suited to airport pickup & drop-off · A small bus that gets into narrow streets easily

vehicle.empty: We could not load the vehicle list. Please refresh the page and try again.
vehicle.notice: This page only takes quote requests. Because the price depends on the route, schedule and vehicle availability, we review your request personally and then send you a quote by text message.

route.name: Route
route.title: Where are you traveling from and to?
route.desc: If your departure point or destination is Incheon Airport, it is an Airport Pickup & Drop-off (Transfer Specialists) route.
route.label: From · To
route.airNote: This is an Airport Pickup & Drop-off (Transfer Specialists) route.
route.waypointsHint: Add any stops along the way. The bus travels in the order you add them. (Up to {max} stops)
route.waypointEmpty: No stops added — the bus goes straight from the departure point to the destination.
route.waypointMax: You can add up to {max} stops
route.error: Please choose both a departure point and a destination.
route.errorWaypoint: Please choose a place for each stop you added, or remove it.

schedule.name: Schedule
schedule.title: When, and how many people?
schedule.desc: We plan the vehicle around your departure date and time. If your schedule is flexible, an estimate is fine.
schedule.returnHint: If it is the same day as departure, it is recorded as a same-day round trip; if it is the next day, as a 2-day, 1-night trip.
schedule.returnOptionalHint: If you don't know your return date and time yet, you can leave them blank.
schedule.onewayNote: You chose one way, so no return date or time is needed.
schedule.capWarn: {vehicle} × {buses} seats up to {total} people. You have {pax} — add more buses, or adjust with our staff after you submit your request.
schedule.capEmpty: Choose a vehicle to see its capacity.
schedule.errorDepart: Please enter the departure date and time.
schedule.errorReturn: Please enter a return date and time after the departure.

options.name: Preferences
options.title: How would you like your quote?
options.desc: Everything here is optional. You can leave it all blank and still submit.
options.parking: Include parking fees in the quote
options.parkingDesc: Would you like a quote that includes parking and toll fees?
options.vatDesc: Check this and we will prepare your quote with VAT included.
options.message: Anything else you'd like to tell us
options.messagePlaceholder: e.g. Please come to the main gate by 7:30 a.m. Many of our group are older, so a bus with low steps would be great.
options.errorMessage: Please keep your message to 1,000 characters or fewer.

contact.name: Contact · Consent
contact.title: How can we reach you?
contact.desc: We only need your name and mobile number to receive your request. Everything else is optional.
contact.phoneHint: Enter it as 010-0000-0000. If you type digits only, hyphens are added automatically.
contact.phoneIntlHint: Start with + and your country code, then digits only. e.g. +14155550123
contact.errorName: Please enter your name. (Up to 30 characters)
contact.errorPhone: Please enter your mobile number as 010-0000-0000.
contact.errorPhoneIntl: Please enter an international number as + and your country code, then digits only.
contact.consentRequired: You need to tick the required consent to submit.
contact.notReadyTitle: Online requests are being set up
contact.notReadyBody: We can't take online requests right now. Please call {tel} and we will help you right away.

done.title: Your quote request has been received
done.codeHint: You can look up your request in Check Booking with this number and the last 4 digits of your mobile number.
done.noCode: We will contact you after reviewing your request.
done.body: We will review your request and send you a quote by text message.
done.sub: There is no online payment. You will not be charged anything before your booking is confirmed. If it is urgent, feel free to call {tel}.
